localRefinements.4: The dogleg left begins earlier than the July 2022 aerial suggests; exact current geometry remains unconfirmed.

greens.matching: Each hole is paired with the golf=green way whose centroid is nearest the last point of its centerline. Practice greens inside the course bounding box are left unassigned.
